ops.title: Keep native branch attachment out of Graphite divergence recovery
ops.description: A native-bound gtTrack with an explicit parent invokes gtRetrackDiverged unconditionally. gtmeta.Diverged reads the Graphite SQLite store directly, so fresh native clones without .graphite_metadata.db refuse before native adoption. Guard only the legacy divergence path for native lanes; preserve actual legacy ownership and recovery. Frozen two-file candidate includes a real Git/native adoption fixture; local tests prohibited, CI and independent exact-head review required.

ops.text: Native explicit-parent attachment succeeds without any Graphite database or gt invocation and preserves source/parent heads
Legacy divergence behavior remains covered and required CI passes
Reviewed source merged, official release/local affected-case proof recorded
